text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, I had a solid trip, and I placed<n>pretty high!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I kept my cool throughout it too, so I<n>don't think it
was a bad race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...But of course, this isn't enough to<n>satisfy me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There are always greater heights, and<n>every
second I waste is a second for<n>the competition to
climb ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I can't do it! Anyway, I'm going<n>to take what I
learned today and<n>apply it to my next race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I have to keep moving<n>forward!

text_block_list.text: I have to keep running until I amsatisfied... until I become my idealself!
